As an OEM organization, we accord top priority to Occupational Health and Safety and have zero tolerance towards any incidences related to it. Our goal is to build an accident-free organisation, so that our employees can work comfortably in a safe and healthy environment. The exposure of employees into the risk area makes them vulnerable to adverse incidents.

The organization provides periodic safety trainings to promote employee wellbeing and to ensure safety at the workplace. The Company, as part of EHS management system, has introduced SHE FMEA (Safety, Health & Environment Failure Mode and Effect analysis). SHE FMEA is a methodology that identifies hazard and assess risk and is adopted to cover all activities & processes for the routine and non-routine activities in normal, exceptional & emergency situations and to identify the failure mode with respect to EHS. It also addresses the gaps because it is a quantitative risk assessment methodology.
